nodes.label: Asset Decoupling of Linguistic & Topic Dictionaries
nodes.rationale: Separates word lists, synonym dictionaries, and regex patterns into JSON files under rules/ so pipeline code focuses strictly on logic and parsing.

nodes.label: Hierarchical Academic Discipline Taxonomy (rules/academic/taxonomy/)
nodes.rationale: Organizes academic subfields, author pools, and journals by discipline with __prompt__ metadata blocks for strict alignment.

nodes.label: UI & Citation Engine Decoupling
nodes.rationale: Citation Engine must remain 100% decoupled from Streamlit or UI dependencies.
